rows.focus: ABSTRACT Background and Aim: Cryopreservation is essential for the long-term preservation and dissemination of superior goat genetics but induces oxidative, osmotic, and thermal stress that compromises sperm quality and fertilizing potential. Mitochondrial dysfunction, lipid peroxidation, and impaired cellular stress responses are major contributors to cryoinjury. Coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10), a mitochondrial electron carrier and potent lipid-soluble antioxidant, has been proposed as a cryoprotective supplement; however, its effects on heat shock protein 70 (HSP70) gene expression and mitochondrial function in cryopreserved Peranakan Ettawa (PE) goat spermatozoa remain insufficiently characterized.
